scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run package:xpi
scripts.package:xpi: npm run stage && mkdir -p web-ext-artifacts && rm -f web-ext-artifacts/firemcp-$npm_package_version.xpi && cd build && zip -qr ../web-ext-artifacts/firemcp-$npm_package_version.xpi .
scripts.lint:amo: npm run build:js && npm run stage && web-ext lint --self-hosted --source-dir build
scripts.sign: npm run build:js && npm run stage && node scripts/sign.mjs
